next_step: Run 72h POC perf sweep on Dedicated (2xA100 equivalent) with batching/caching/quantization knobs; follow-up review with infra + procurement
blockers: p99 tail latency SLA not yet agreed
notes: Focus: sub-50ms median, p95 < 50ms, p99 < 120ms for reranking calls at 10k-20k qps in peak windows.
Primary workload: ad auction & personalization — very latency sensitive, also highly cost conscious (target unit cost < $0.0005 per inference).
Model preferences: open models (Llama-2 family) with quantization to 4-bit/8-bit; evaluating custom distilled variants + Redwood-verified kernels.
Optimize interest: batching policies that maintain tail SLAs, prefix/KV caching (user history reuse), and quantization profiles to trade cost vs quality.
Quote from CTO (call 2025-02-10): "If p99 spikes, revenue drops — need predictable tails and graceful fallback to smaller model variants."
Benchmarking ask: Redwood to run perf sweep across batch sizes (1,2,4,8,16), cache hit rates (0%,25%,50%), and quant levels (fp16, int8, q4_k) using our representative prompt set.
Data residency: must keep PII-related user segments in US region; audit logs required for every inference for first 30 days.
Routing requirement: region-aware routing, auto-fallback to cheaper model variant when Dedicated pool saturates, option to fail-open to hosted API for bursts up to 5% traffic.
Current infra: internal bidder service on k8s feeding 200ms budget per round-trip; want to shave model latency to 20-40ms to preserve headroom for network + business logic.
Cost sensitivity: procurement has threshold at $X/day; team asks for clear cost per 1M requests under each config (batching + quantization).
Provided artifacts: sample logs, 30k request prompt set, and synthetic QPS/latency distribution (drive links attached).
Security review status: SSO/SAML support required, SOC2 in progress, Redwood security FAQ being filled out by SE (see drive doc).
Decision criteria: meet p95 SLA in POC, evidence of >2x cost reduction with quantization+batching without >5% quality regression in rerank score.
Preference for dedicated pool with configurable autoscaling and burst credit model; fallback policy must be testable in POC.

use_case_summary: High-volume adtech bidder that needs millisecond-accurate reranking and personalization. Priorities are strict tail latency, predictable unit economics, and ability to run quantized open models in a VPC/Dedicated environment. POC will validate batching, caching, and quantization knobs to hit p95/p99 SLAs while reducing per-inference cost.
